name: mirage
text:
Released v1.0.46, everything you asked for in one release: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.46
• Bet slip: a big red X (ALREADY HELD) when you already hold the same side, or another line of the same team, player or prop in that game, counting your open bets and the engine's orders and resting bids.
• A bet the slip finds no longer offered at the listed odds (or no longer +EV) leaves the list at once and returns only if a newer price lists it again.
• Diversification for bets and bids (engine and phone): one bet per side (I set that on the engine now), at most 6 bets in one game, at most $12 on one team/player/prop of a game, and the one-line-per-player/team rule now applies to bids too.
• Restart-proof: the live lane, bid desk and auto-bet count the engine's carried ledger, so a restart gives nothing back. The engine is restarted on this code now.
Still open: reading Novig's own open positions in the engine (DV4), so bets placed outside the engine count too.
